hook.name: DynopegHook
hook.description: Applies a flat 3% ETH tax on every swap involving native ETH: on the buy side, reduces the swap input via BeforeSwapDelta and mints ERC-6909 claims; on the sell side, extracts ETH via poolManager.take() in afterSwap. Also advances a rolling per-swap entropy seed each call. Anyone can call normalize() to convert accumulated claims to physical ETH and push them to the DynopegToken reward distributor.
